<title
    level="1"
    right="Feat 1"
    pfs="Standard"
>
[Hail of Splinters](/Feats.aspx?ID=4282) <actions string="Two Actions" />
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Impulse" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=502" />
<trait label="Kineticist" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=504" />
<trait label="Overflow" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=506" />
<trait label="Primal" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=134" />
<trait label="Wood" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=508" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Rage of Elements](/Sources.aspx?ID=205) pg. 34

</column>

---

A fusillade of jagged splinters flies from you. Creatures in a 30-foot cone take 1d4 piercing damage and 1d4 [persistent bleed damage](/Conditions.aspx?ID=29) with a [basic](/Rules.aspx?ID=329) Reflex save against your class DC.

---
**Level (+2)** Each type of damage increases by 1d4.
name: Hail of Splinters
